title: Remote viewing inside a Russian particle beam weapon

tellings.quote: >> But uh what I got was that the uh the particles in the beam are not shooting straight like light does. They swirl as they go.

plain: Army Sergeant Lyn Buchanan says that sometime in the 1980s he used remote viewing, a trained attempt to see hidden targets with the mind alone, to look inside a Soviet particle beam weapon, a weapon that fires a stream of tiny particles. He says what he saw was that the particles do not shoot straight the way light does: "They swirl as they go." He tells it as someone who did the viewing himself.
